lane: Mobile + backend + Admin: server check at app start with 24h offline grace and soft minimum version (Owner decisions 27-28/11/2026)
goal: Every app start (guest or signed in) asks the server once for the release policy and the published Free/Premium switch before showing content. Success stores the time; failure within 24 hours of the last success opens an offline mode (journal and already-loaded content work, AI and server features say a connection is needed); beyond 24 hours or with no prior success a full-screen 'Mất kết nối – Thử lại' blocks the app. An app older than the Owner-set minimum version gets a reminder with a Google Play button and keeps working for the Owner-set number of days, then a 'Cần cập nhật' screen. The Free/Premium switch is fed into the app and wired to the one built feature (book_quote).
successCriteria: Migration supabase/migrations/20261128090000_app_release_policy.sql: table public.app_release_policies (versioned, RLS on, no direct grants), Owner-only RPC set_app_release_policy(min_version, grace_days 0-30, reason 10-500) with audit, and get_app_bootstrap() granted to anon and authenticated returning only {serverTime, releasePolicy:{minVersion, graceDays, effectiveAt}|null, featureAccess:<active published config>|null}. PGlite test replays it.
No Edge Function: the bootstrap is one RPC, so no deploy is needed; the Owner still approves the SQL hash.

Mobile StartupGate wraps the app above AccountBoundary: states checking / online / offline-grace / offline-blocked / update-reminder / update-required; 8 second timeout; recheck on foreground when the last check is older than 5 minutes; device-level AsyncStorage key nilaza.bootstrap.v1 holds lastSuccessAt and the last policy.
Offline grace window is exactly 24 hours from lastSuccessAt on the device clock; offline mode shows a persistent banner; existing per-feature offline errors stay as they are.
Version comparison uses the app version string (expo-constants expoConfig.version, e.g. 0.1.3) with numeric segment compare; minimum version unset = no reminder.
featureAccessService is configured from the bootstrap payload (no second network call); BookQuoteScreen respects useFeatureAccess('book_quote') through PremiumGate.
Admin: Owner can view and set minimum version and grace days (Owner-only publish with reason) in the existing Switches area; non-Owner sees read-only.
Bilingual vi/en copy for all new screens; TalkBack labels on retry and Play buttons.
Checks: mobile tsc + jest (StartupGate tests for each state and the 24h edge), admin:check + admin:test, PGlite SQL test, validate:backend, supabase:check, migration-ledger check, feature preflight.
untouchedSurfaces: AI Edge Functions and their quotas: unchanged; they already refuse unauthenticated calls and fail offline.
Journal sync queue: unchanged; it already stores offline edits and syncs later.
Content files stay bundled in this task; moving content to the server is the separate approved task (book quotes first).
account-tier-policy.json stays all_premium during testing (Owner decision 27/11).

impact.entryPoint: Every app launch and every return from background after 5 minutes. New full-screen states: Mất kết nối – Thử lại; Cần cập nhật. New banner: Đang ngoại tuyến; reminder for an old app version. Admin: Switches area > Phiên bản app tối thiểu.
impact.dataWrite: Device: nilaza.bootstrap.v1 (lastSuccessAt, last policy) and the existing nilaza.featureAccess.v1. Server: new table public.app_release_policies, admin_audit_logs rows on publish.
impact.backendContract: New RPC public.get_app_bootstrap() (anon + authenticated, read-only, no personal data) and public.set_app_release_policy(...) (ai.manage = Owner).
impact.adminVisibility: Owner sees current minimum version, grace days, who set it, when and why; history in admin_audit_logs.
impact.privacySafety: Bootstrap returns only public configuration and server time; no user identifiers are sent or stored. Offline mode never opens AI.
impact.observability: Blind spot: no counter yet for blocked-offline or update-required screens.
impact.rollback: Clearing the minimum version disables reminders and blocks. If the RPC breaks, users inside 24 hours keep offline mode; an outage longer than 24 hours blocks new launches (accepted cost of the Owner decision); a hotfix build can widen the window.

sourceReview.reason: Approval boundaries: SQL, deploy, secrets and builds need the Owner.
Routes cross-cutting mobile + backend + Admin work.
Startup order: PasswordRecoveryBoundary > EmailConfirmationBoundary > AccountBoundary; splash hide rules; guest preview and onboarding gates.
getPublishedFeatureAccess (anon + signed-in) and BackendUnavailableError offline/busy mapping reused by the bootstrap call.
Cache key nilaza.featureAccess.v1 and configureFeatureAccess (never called yet) that the bootstrap will feed.
onlineModeRequired / guestEntryEnabled flags the gate must respect.
Pattern for an Owner-only versioned config with audit and an anon-readable getter.
Record fields, preflight rules and validation commands.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Impact brief written, Owner approvals for SQL and build listed; admin-runtime-parity: the new Admin field has a real consumer (StartupGate).

dependencyReview.evidence: No new package: offline is detected from the failed or timed-out bootstrap call and AppState; the app version is read from apps/mobile/app.json expo.version (bundled at build time), because expo-constants is not a declared mobile dependency and no package may be added.

securityReview.authzRls: New table RLS on, privileges revoked from public/anon/authenticated; writes only through a security definer RPC with set search_path = '' checking nilaza_private.has_capability('ai.manage'); getter returns public config only.
securityReview.sensitiveData: None: the bootstrap carries public configuration and server time only; no user id, token contents or device id is sent or stored by the new code.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secrets in the app or migration; the anon key already in the app is the only credential used for guests; nothing new is logged.
securityReview.externalInput: set_app_release_policy validates min_version against a strict semver pattern, grace_days 0-30 and reason 10-500 characters; the app validates the bootstrap shape and falls back to cache/defaults on anything unexpected.
securityReview.dependencies: No new npm package or native module; expo-constants is already part of expo.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Additive migration (new table, two functions, grants). Applied only after Owner approval of its exact SHA-256; the app tolerates the RPC being absent (treated as unreachable, so the 24h window applies), so the build must not ship before the SQL is applied.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop and ask the Owner if the gate would block Play review flows, if an existing screen depends on startup order in a way the gate breaks, or if the SQL needs anything beyond additive objects.

managerTestPath: Sau khi Owner duyệt SQL và có bản build mới: mở app có mạng -> vào bình thường. Tắt mạng, mở lại trong 24 giờ -> vào được, thấy dải Đang ngoại tuyến, nhật ký đọc/viết được, Trò chuyện báo cần mạng. Cài mới khi không có mạng -> màn Mất kết nối, bấm Thử lại khi có mạng -> vào app. Admin đặt phiên bản tối thiểu cao hơn bản đang cài, 3 ngày -> app hiện lời nhắc có nút Google Play, vẫn dùng được; sau 3 ngày -> màn Cần cập nhật.
residualRisk: Device clock changes can stretch the 24h window (accepted: only on-device content opens). A Supabase outage longer than 24 hours blocks app starts. Client-side gating can be bypassed by a modified app (accepted for on-device features).
note: Owner decisions: 27/11 guests read the switch; 28/11 plan approved, 24h offline kept, old app versions get a reminder and keep working for some days. The plan text first named an Edge Function app-bootstrap; the record uses one SQL RPC instead (same behaviour, no deploy, smaller surface).
